title: AttractionRule
content:
Type: AORU
Papyrus: None An AttractionRule is used as part of a game system that causes Actors to react to specific events that occur around them. These rules are specified on a Keywords Attraction Type property. The AttractionRule object is found within the Object Window under the Miscellaneous Category.
